name: Sanman
area: Behind Hotel Apsara, Alibaug town near bus stand
signature_dish: Surmai fish thali with sol kadhi
why_it_matters: Alibaug's Malvani-Gomantak seafood anchor at the bus-stand lane — open since 1981, three generations. Fish is morning-landed at Alibaug fish auction; the surmai thali (rice + mackerel curry + fried fish + sol kadhi) is the lunch order. Jeetada (barramundi) fry is the under-the-radar standout. AC + non-AC sections. 4.0+ across 400+ Tripadvisor reviews.
insider_tip: Surmai thali sells out by 1:30pm — book a 12pm table on weekends. Parking is tight in the lane; park at the government school compound 50m up. Cards + UPI.

name: Hotel Patang
why_it_matters: Family-run fish-thali stop 7km south of Alibaug town on the Revdanda road — catches the Chaul + Revdanda day-trippers who don't want to detour back into Alibaug for lunch. Surmai + pomfret thalis are the orders. Sundays queue heavy 1-2pm.
insider_tip: Order the surmai thali (₹450) with extra sol kadhi — the brick-red kokum-coconut digestive is the Konkan-coast palate cleanser. Arrive by 12:15 on Sundays.

name: Hotel Sagar Savali
why_it_matters: Beach-road seafood specialist 1km from Alibaug main beach. Spacious dining (rare for Alibaug). Pomfret + surmai + tiger prawn rotate on the daily catch board. Vegetarian options exist but the kitchen is non-veg-led. Terrace seating opens to casuarinas at sunset.
insider_tip: Crab masala is the value-for-money order on weekends — ₹450 for whole-cracked crab. Book a terrace table for 7:30pm to catch sunset.
signature_address: Alibaug Beach Road, near main beach, Alibaug 402201

name: Kokum & Spice
signature_dish: Malvani fish thali with kombdi vade
why_it_matters: Alibaug Malvani-cuisine specialist — coconut-heavy Malvani gravies (distinct from the Gomantak Goan style at Sanman). Kombdi vade (Konkan country chicken with crispy rice-flour vade flatbread) is the lunch combo. Tripadvisor reviews place it among the town's top fish thali stops.
insider_tip: Kombdi vade combo (₹400) is the order if you're tired of fish — Maharashtra's village-Konkan signature. Sol kadhi (kokum + coconut) free with every thali.
signature_address: Alibaug main town, near bus stand, Alibaug 402201

name: Bohemyan Blue Garden Cafe
why_it_matters: Garden cafe on the Alibaug-Mandwa road run by local women from Alibaug villages — Konkani-Lebanese fusion in a setting of hammocks, swings, starry lights and a craft shop with cotton clothing + essential oils. The only Alibaug cafe with a stay extension (Bohemyan Blue rustic AC tents + pool). Tripadvisor ratings consistently 4.0+.
insider_tip: Skip lunch rush 1-3pm and arrive after 4pm for the swing seats. The raw pumpkin salad + mezze platter combo is the under-₹1000 lunch order for two. Cash + UPI; weekend reservations essential.
signature_address: Plot 1, Alibaug-Mandwa Road, Agarsure, opposite Fountainhead, Alibaug 402208

name: Hotel Suruchi
why_it_matters: Pure-veg Alibaug-Pen road stop popular with families arriving by road from Mumbai — ample parking (rare for Alibaug). The vada pav + pav bhaji are the orders; full breakfast (idli, dosa, sabudana) before 11am, lunch thali 12-3pm. Useful as a non-fish alternative for groups with vegetarian travellers.
insider_tip: Vada pav (₹35) + cutting chai (₹15) combo is the standard road-trip break order. UPI + cards. Open 7am-11pm.
